title: FEIDS-26 reinforcements: Isao calls them when the radar stands, the owner's cinematic drops four MX-06 Ridgebacks beside the arena three days later at a lull (or at THE ARENA's start), and they walk the planet as rotor + lancer + two quivers at the top tier
context: Owner, 2026-10-23: 'the goal will be to have Isao call out planetary re-inforcements after having built the radar, and after a few in-game days the FEIDS26 will come. ... we will reproduce the cinematic with the same scene, and they will land at the Arena (before the boss fight.), 2 will stay near the arena, 2 will roam the map.' Then: 'the Arena pair DOES join the boss fight, the roaming ones; 1 makes its way to the main base, the other roams and hunts enemies. they are equipped with rotor + lancer + 2x quivers at max upgraded specs.' Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-23-feids26-reinforcements-design.md; the owner's own assets (SentryTowers_A6 feids26/ and ridgeback-mech/, 'Models by jelaludo') and three sounds from his Downloads. Built overnight on branch feids26-drop from day-42 c96d6ded, not pushed.
outcome: Assets: feids26_d0_lod1/lod2 and mx06_d0_lod1/lod2 pinned at SentryTowers_A6 38eed564 (docs/feids26-assets.lock.json, sha256 equal to the upstream manifests, clips checked by assets:check), the three sounds as feids_reentry (0.45, quieter than the mechs), mech_reentry_woosh and mech_landing_impact, lazy, on the ambient bus, in the version 8 sound list (docs/feids26-audio.lock.json). The timeline is a pure rule (src/domain/reinforcements.js: capsuleState, cargoState with the Airdrop_Land clip's clock, touchdowns 13.00 / 13.43 / 14.00 / 19.23 s, dropCues, dropCamera, dropReady, dropCentre; numbers in src/content/reinforcements.js). The scene (src/fx/feids-drop.js) poses two capsules (Shell_Separate on the opening's clock, the shield glow, the split flash) and four Ridgebacks (Airdrop_Land at the rule's clock, DROP_ROOT held at zero; hidden while held in the closed shell instead of porting the leg fold) in a tangent frame 5 cells down the heart's field from the arena's cell, with the game's tank.flash and rock.dust, and the cues on the drop's clock. The host (src/fx/reinforcements-host.js) books story.reinforcements { calledDay, due = +3 days } when the radar prints (perk uplink) or at once when the uplink already stands, shows reinforcements_called and the callout, starts the drop at the first lull after the due day (never over a seat, shot, card or line), or at THE ARENA's start due or not, or at once on ?reinforce=1 (?reinforce=0 never), primes the three lazy sounds and fetches the models before it goes, says reinforcements_inbound and holds a live, skippable 28 s cut on the cinematic's camera. The four (src/fx/mech-squad.js, src/domain/mech-roles.js) each own four sentry records (rotor, lancer, quiver, quiver at MAX_TIER, `mech` read by autoTower) in a second list tower-combat fires (host.mechTowers), not in the controller's towers, towerByCell or shop; their rigs carry tower-aim's angles onto the GLB's minigun and laser pivots and the shots leave from its muzzle sockets; the arena pair walks the arena floor off the crater, the base mech parks two cells outside the gate down the heart's field, the hunter takes the shortest way to the nearest live enemy two cells off the hull; pace 0.25 cells/s, Walk_Cycle capped at rate 4; one InstancedMesh a part for the four (608 -> 152 draw calls up close) and the one-draw far tier past 140 m.
alternatives: Pushing the sixteen records into the controller's towers list, as the spec first said: that list feeds the story's sentry cap, the shop count, the seats, the walkers' hits and the arsenal's keep-cells, all of which the spec keeps the mechs out of; a second list for tower-combat keeps them out by construction.

Porting the leg fold (packMech: poseLeg and solveHydraulics) to show the folded cargo inside the opening shell: the spec's fallback was taken (the shell is opaque; the mechs show from their release), and the Airdrop_Land clip gives the legs' deploy and the touchdown's compression instead of porting the IK.

The ground camera at the upstream 0.2 m: the game camera's near plane is 0.004 units, 3 m at the story's scale, and at 1 m the floor under the lens clipped and the planet's far side showed through; it sits 3.5 m up and 9 m off the laggard.
Holding the arena drop to the due day: a run reaching THE ARENA inside three days of the call would fight the boss without them; the spec says at once.
evidence: npm test 300 programs (new: feids26-assets, reinforcements, mech-roles, mech-squad), npm run check, npm run architecture (td-tab 5,320 under 5,450), npm run build: green on the final tree.

--reinforcements (headless, port 18182): dropping 1.1 s after the world stood; touchdowns heard at 13.00 / 13.44 / 14.00 / 19.24 s on the drop's game clock (rule 13.00 / 13.43 / 14.00 / 19.23); wooshes 4 s ahead of each; both capsule entries; 10 of 10 cues voiced; the cut held and released; four mechs in their roles with four tier-2 records each; 30 game s on the base mech 263 -> 256 hops from the heart, the hunter 8 cells walked, the arena pair on the plain; bodies beside them fired on; the four game-tier mechs 608 calls in the drop's view, 152 instanced up close; THE ARENA first (?boss=1, no flag) dropped before the due day with the four.
--reinforcements-lull: called on day 1 at the load (the radar standing), due day 4, nothing on days 1-3, dropped on day 4 at a culled breath, four landed.
--arena green with the drop in it (the arena-first drop at its start).
Before the priming fix every cue was asked and refused (the lazy sounds were never decoded) while the harness's ask counter passed: the step now asserts a live voice per cue.
